title: Discounts Added Back before a Service Charge is Worked, Crop Input Purchasing Accounts
content:
Where an account has taken the cooperative's settlement concessions and then let the balance run to the level at which buying is suspended, some or all of those concessions are added back to the balance the service charge is worked on.

**Clause.** Where two or more discounts stand granted on the account over the 10 statement months before the handling date and the overdue balance has reached the programme's suspension threshold, the concession those discounts gave for settling inside the window is taken back in full, so the share added back is the whole of them — 100 percent. Where one discount stands granted on the account over those months and the overdue balance has reached the programme's suspension threshold, that concession is taken back in part, so the share added back is half of them — 50 percent. In every other case no share of the discounts is added back on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts.

| Discounts granted over the 10 statement months | Overdue balance against the programme's suspension threshold | Share of those discounts added back |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2 or more | at or above the threshold | 100 percent |
| exactly 1 | at or above the threshold | 50 percent |
| 2 or more | below the threshold | No share is added back |
| none | either | No share is added back |

## The suspension threshold, programme by programme

| Programme | Suspension threshold (USD) |
| --- | --- |
| Cash Purchase Account | 0 |
| Standard 30-Day Charge Account | 25000 |
| Seasonal Terms Crop Input Account | 75000 |
| Early Pay Prepay Program Account | 0 |
| Full Acre Input Financing Account | 150000 |
| Precision Partner Input Program Account | 250000 |

The share added back is a share of the money those discounts gave, added to the overdue balance before the rate is taken on it.
